## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why is this important?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered
What alternative solutions or workarounds exist?

## Expected Behavior
What would the user experience be with this feature?

## Acceptance Criteria
What needs to be true for this feature to be considered complete?
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots that might help.
